debug_level.description: Debug verbosity level for hp-search-mac output.

switches.description: List of HP switches to search for MAC addresses. Each item is a map with 'host' and 'community'. This corresponds to the Perl hash %switches in the man page.

switches.items.description: Configuration for a single HP switch entry in the switches hash. Not a valid type for values_schema items, but flattened fields are below.

switches.items.host.description: Hostname or IP address of the HP switch.

switches.items.community.description: SNMP community string (read-only) for the HP switch.
